title: Bondurant Middle School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. may 14-17, 2027
bodyHtml:
*Bondurant Middle School requires all travelers to purchase Travel Protection in order to attend the trip.

*Please complete your registration and deposit payment on Landmark’s website, and email proof of purchase of Travel Protection—including the CFAR add-on—to angela@landmarkeducationaltours.com

Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Bondurant Middle School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the 9/11 Pentagon Memorial
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (three nights)
 

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & National Archives Museum

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Wreath Laying Ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the People’s House
  • Photo Opp at The White House
  • Lunch
  • Visit the National Archives Museum
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Guided Ghost Tour of Alexandria
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: International Spy Museum & United States Capitol Building  

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the International Spy Museum
  • Lunch
  • Public Guided Tour of the United States Capitol Building
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture
  • DJ Dinner Cruise!
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate
  • Lunch Voucher
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Bondurant Middle School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From solemn memorials to spine-tingling ghost tours, this Washington, D.C. experience is packed with history, excitement, and unforgettable moments at every turn! Students will explore the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History, walk the hallowed grounds of Arlington National Cemetery, and uncover secrets at the International Spy Museum. They'll also tour the United States Capitol Building, discover powerful stories at the National Museum of African American History and Culture, and cap off the adventure with an incredible DJ Dinner Cruise. It's the perfect mix of education, inspiration, and excitement — an experience your students will never forget!
